name: Tofu Pepper Fry
ingredients: 1 tsp fennel seeds and 1 tsp crushed black peppercorns
1 tsp each ginger and garlic, minced
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Sear the tofu in a non-stick pan with half the oil until golden; set aside.
Heat the remaining oil, add fennel and curry leaves, then the onion, ginger and garlic. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, turmeric and coriander powder and cook for 4 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the pepper and 2 tbsp water, and toss for 3 minutes until dry.
Finish with salt and lemon juice.
note: A South Indian style dry fry; freshly crushed pepper is the main seasoning.
